title: Chicken Cluck
blurb: Chickens have well over twenty distinct calls, and this is the everyday chatter one. Contented clucking from a hen going quietly about her business, the background texture of every farmyard scene ever filmed. Not the alarm call. Not the egg song. It is a staple for cartoon edits, farm-themed videos and passive-aggressively calling somebody a coward without using words. It also lands disproportionately well in a silent moment on a work call, which is not a use the hen ever consented to.
origin: A field recording of a hen clucking.
